sources.title: 愚者の館（Fool）— マブラヴ 攻略
sources.notes: Directly inspected complete Japanese choice-by-choice chart, credited to Fool, checked without a patch; expressly covers both CD and DVD versions and identifies its only DVD-only recovery branch outside EXTRA. Supplies the intact six-section EXTRA sequence, both daily-life detours, exact ending labels and numbered saves 1–5. The route text follows this complete sequence; independently evidenced transcription corrections are listed in disagreements. No Unlimited content is emitted.

sources.title: ガルバスラ — マブラヴ攻略（index）
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese walkthrough by 紅堂幹人; the index explicitly identifies the walkthrough as his own and dates the original work to 2003/02/27–2003/03/06. Links all component pages. Confirms 8 EXTRA endings; combat-minigame options may vary without changing route access.

sources.title: ガルバスラ — エクストラ・オールエンド
sources.notes: Directly inspected complete independent eight-ending chart. Explicitly targets scenario 1.00E.1030, the 2003/02/28 release without updates. Confirms five heroine outcomes, both daily endings and Marimo, as well as saves before the daily-ending branches. Different early affection-balancing prefix from A; used for route-defining decisions, ending names and corresponding literal menu evidence, not represented as the identical A playthrough.

sources.title: ガルバスラ — 鑑 純夏 攻略
sources.notes: Directly inspected individual original-PC Japanese route chart, independent of Fool. Supports the same intended ending and material route chain with a different valid early prefix. Choice numbers, spelling and some optional early decisions differ from A; quotations preserve this source’s text. These component pages and the all-end chart are one author/source, not counted as separate independent guides.

sources.title: FlirtingNavi — マブラヴ（Extra編・Unlimited編）攻略
sources.notes: Directly inspected additional contemporary Japanese route-by-route walkthrough explicitly dated to the 2003/2/28 release. Distinct prefixes and explanatory footnotes provide third-source corroboration, including both daily-ending conditions, conditional 12/23 selector, and the fact that the original game has only a Marimo bad ending. Supplies exact corresponding choice literals when the Galle variant differs. It is not used as a copy of Fool or as English evidence.

sources.title: gialzirou — Yet Another Muv-Luv Extra/Unlimited Walkthrough
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent written English walkthrough. Author records personal play, experiments, updates and a distinct all-in-one EXTRA route rather than translation of A/B. Its explicit target is all-ages Steam, so it corroborates only unchanged route structure and the five heroine/two common outcomes. It expressly says the Marimo scene continues rather than ending there. This difference is reconciled as edition-specific; it does not override the original-CD Japanese terminal or supply Japanese quotes.

sources.title: oblaarg — Muv-Luv review and Spoilerific Mechanics Guide
sources.notes: Directly inspected supplementary firsthand written mechanics report from 2011 after the author’s completed playthrough. Not a full choice-by-choice E walkthrough. Independently discusses the two daily-ending conditions, heroine routing, and original-version Marimo bad ending, distinguishing its own experiments from the translation-bundled walkthrough. Used only for this narrower corroboration.
